Delhi lawyers protest Motor Vehicles Act rule, government halts new system

Lawyers in Delhi went on strike protesting a rule related to the Motor Vehicles Act, specifically concerning the 50% payment of traffic challans. Following the lawyers' protest, the Delhi government has put a halt to the new system. The lawyers' slogan was "Dictatorship will not be tolerated!"
